use_when: 输入法
IME框架
文本输入
键盘
输入法应用
如何实现一个完整的输入法应用，包括生命周期管理和Panel创建？
如何配置输入法子类型以支持多语言和多模式切换？
如何在自绘编辑框（ArkTS/C/C++）中绑定输入法实现文字输入？
如何实现输入法应用的沉浸模式通信机制？
输入法安全模式（基础模式和完整体验模式）有什么区别？
如何在不可获焦窗口中实现输入框与输入法的交互？
如何切换输入法应用？
如何使用Ime调试工具进行输入法开发调试？
当您需要开发一款输入法应用时，可使用 IME Kit 的输入法服务 API 来创建软键盘窗口、插入删除字符、选中文本、监听物理键盘按键事件等
当您的应用使用自绘编辑框（如游戏内的聊天输入框、富文本编辑器等）需要绑定输入法进行文字输入时，可使用 IME Kit 的输入法框架 API，支持 ArkTS 和 C/C++ 两种开发方式
开发自定义软键盘并处理候选词上屏 / Build a custom soft keyboard and commit candidate text
在输入法扩展里创建键盘面板和候选栏界面 / Create keyboard panels and candidate bar UI in an input method extension
实现拼音联想、候选词更新和选词提交 / Implement Pinyin suggestions, candidate updates, and candidate commit
监听物理键盘按键并把按键转换成输入内容 / Listen for hardware key events and turn them into input text
向当前编辑框插入文字、删除字符和替换选中内容 / Insert text, delete characters, and replace selected text in the active editor
获取光标位置和选中文本以驱动输入法编辑逻辑 / Get cursor position and selected text to drive IME editing logic
让自定义编辑控件接入系统输入法并弹出键盘 / Connect a custom editor to the system IME and show the keyboard
实现多语言键盘布局切换和输入模式切换 / Implement multilingual keyboard layout switching and input mode switching
管理输入法扩展的激活、切前台和生命周期状态 / Manage IME extension activation, foreground switching, and lifecycle state
在沉浸式场景下让键盘与宿主应用通信 / Enable communication between the keyboard and host app in immersive scenarios
适配安全输入场景，限制输入法能力并保护敏感内容 / Adapt to secure input scenarios, restrict IME capabilities, and protect sensitive content
在不可聚焦浮窗或特殊窗口里完成文字输入交互 / Enable text input interaction in non-focusable floating or special windows
preconditions: 工程已集成HarmonyOS对应版本的IME Kit能力并可解析相关API / The project has integrated the target HarmonyOS IME Kit capability and its APIs are resolvable
若开发输入法应用，应用类型、能力配置及必要声明已在module.json5等配置中完成 / If developing an IME app, the app type, capability configuration, and necessary declarations have been completed in module.json5 and related config
若绑定自绘编辑框，编辑组件已具备可接收与同步文本、选区、光标状态的实现基础 / If binding a custom editor, the editor implementation is ready to receive and synchronize text, selection, and cursor state

若涉及输入法切换、启用或安全/沉浸模式能力，设备系统版本与系统授权条件满足要求 / If IME switching, enablement, or security/immersive mode features are involved, the device OS version and required system authorization conditions are satisfied
inputs: 编辑框实例或自绘编辑上下文 / editor instance or custom editing context
文本内容、光标位置与选区信息 / text content, cursor position, and selection information
输入法Panel类型与界面配置 / IME panel type and UI configuration
输入法子类型配置（语言、模式等） / IME subtype configuration such as language and mode
outputs: 输入法扩展能力实例（InputMethodExtensionAbility） / Input method extension ability instance (InputMethodExtensionAbility)
输入法能力对象（InputMethodAbility） / Input method ability object (InputMethodAbility)
输入法面板对象（Panel，固定态、悬浮态或状态栏类型） / Input method panel object (Panel: fixed, floating, or status-bar type)
键盘控制器对象（KeyboardController） / Keyboard controller object (KeyboardController)
文本输入客户端对象（TextInputClient） / Text input client object (TextInputClient)
输入法控制器对象（InputMethodController） / Input method controller object (InputMethodController)
输入法设置管理对象（InputMethodSetting） / Input method setting and management object (InputMethodSetting)
输入法属性描述信息（InputMethodProperty） / Input method property descriptor (InputMethodProperty)
输入法子类型信息（InputMethodSubtype，多语言、多模式） / Input method subtype information (InputMethodSubtype: multilingual and multimode)
自绘编辑框与输入法的绑定会话或文本编辑代理 / Custom editor input-method binding session or text editing proxy

postconditions.statement: 代码已建立应用编辑框与输入法之间的绑定或通信通道 / The code establishes a binding or communication channel between the app editor and the IME
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/configuration that connects a custom editor or app text input flow with IME APIs, rather than only handling generic input events?

postconditions.statement: 已实现至少一项输入法文本交互能力，如插入、删除、选中或光标移动 / At least one IME text interaction capability is implemented, such as insert, delete, selection, or cursor movement
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there evidence that IME-driven text operations such as inserting text, deleting text, updating selection, or moving the cursor are handled?

postconditions.statement: 若目标是输入法应用，已新增或完善输入法生命周期、Panel或子类型相关实现 / If the target is an IME app, IME lifecycle, panel, or subtype related implementation has been added or refined
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task is about building an IME app, do the edits include IME-specific app logic such as lifecycle handling, panel creation, or subtype configuration?
